name: expand
description: Jira REST `expand` header, carried through from raw unchanged.

name: id
description: Jira issue id as string. NULLABLE so a bad export becomes a DQ finding in 02_dq_stage.sql rather than a load failure.

name: self
description: REST API URL of the issue.

name: key
description: Jira issue key, e.g. ITV-1453. NULLABLE so a bad export becomes a DQ finding in 02_dq_stage.sql rather than a load failure.

name: fields
description: Untyped issue payload carried forward from raw.

name: payload_hash
description: FARM_FINGERPRINT(TO_JSON_STRING(fields)); used to collapse byte-identical duplicate snapshots.

name: dt
description: Run date the snapshot was loaded for. Partition key.

name: etl_ts
description: UTC time this row was written to stage. Unlike dt, it is not rewritten by a backfill, so it records when the load actually ran.
